title: Green Card — Processamento Consular
subtitle: Descubra se o processamento consular (I-130 + DS-260 + I-864) é o caminho certo para o seu caso.
subtitle_en: Find out whether consular processing (I-130 + DS-260 + I-864) is the right path for your case.

questions.label_en: Has the beneficiary ever lived in the United States without legal status for more than 180 days, at any point, before leaving the country?
